observations.series_label: Game software industry (JSIC 3914) establishment persons engaged
observations.definition: National persons engaged in privately owned establishments classified as 3914 Game software industry. JSIC 3914 covers creation of game software, including components, for home-TV consoles, portable electronic games and PCs, plus related research, analysis and advice; it excludes game-cassette and game-optical-disc manufacturing.
observations.methodology: 2016 Economic Census Activity Survey, establishment industry tabulation, Service Industries B detailed class. The official results note says industry tabulations exclude management/support-activity establishments and establishments for which industry-specific-item values were not obtained. This matches the restriction wording in the accepted 2012 establishment tabulation.
observations.scope_limits: Domestic establishment-industry classification. It is not all employment at diversified game publishers or console-hardware companies, not a developer occupation count, and not an FTE or contractor total.
observations.source_locator: Official e-Stat download, Table 1, row '3914 ゲームソフトウェア業': establishment count 256; persons engaged 18,216. Official results overview p. 2, item 4: same industry-tabulation exclusion rule.
observations.assessment: primary official source; exact dated detailed-class observation. It can extend the accepted 2012 census series, subject to the existing integration review.

unresolved.reason: The official final-results catalogue inspected publishes cross-industry worker tables at middle classification, while its service-industry worker table excludes G Information and Communications. No official detailed-class 3914 worker row was located. Do not substitute 391 Software industry, game-centre employment, enterprise sales, or total Information and Communications employment.
